index.UIText_BackupManagerDescription: Inspect your restore points, compare save statistics, and download or restore a backup when needed.
index.UIText_Discord_Info: Join the Discord and help make SSUI better or get support!
index.UIText_UpdateAvailable: A new version of SSUI is ready to install and will be installed the next time you restart the application.
index.UIText_UpdateFailed: Update failed. Please try again later.
index.UIText_BackupAnalysisFailed: The save file could not be analyzed.

config.UIText_PleaseSelectSection: Please select a configuration section above
config.UIText_UseWizardAlternative: Alternatively, use the Configuration Wizard to configure the server.
config.UIText_BackupRetentionIntro: Choose how SSUI preserves useful restore points while removing old backups.
config.UIText_BackupCleanupInfo: Enable scheduled cleanup for the SSUI-managed backups folders.
config.UIText_BackupKeepNewestInfo: Number of newest backups kept regardless of age. Set to 0 to disable this rule.
config.UIText_BackupKeepDailyInfo: Keep one backup per calendar day for this many days. Set to 0 to disable.
config.UIText_BackupKeepWeeklyInfo: Keep one backup per ISO calendar week for this many weeks. Set to 0 to disable.
config.UIText_BackupKeepMonthlyInfo: Keep one backup per calendar month for this many months. Set to 0 to disable.
config.UIText_BackupCleanupIntervalInfo: Hours between cleanup runs. Must be greater than 0.
config.UIText_BackupWarning: When cleanup is enabled, autosaves older than 24 hours and Safebackups not covered by this policy are permanently deleted.
config.UIText_BackupCopyDelayInfo: SSUI checks for new or changed autosaves every 45 seconds. Readable archives with complete world.xml and world_meta.xml files are copied to Safebackups; incomplete files are retried later.

tabDescriptions.UIText_ServerConfigTabDescription: Here you can configure settings related to your gameserver like basic settings like server name and password, network settings like ports and UPnP, and SSUI settings like automatic SSUI updates, scheduled gameserver restarts and more.
tabDescriptions.UIText_DiscordIntegrationTabDescription: Configure the Discord integration for real-time server status updates, remote management, player connection tracking, and community engagement. Learn more about the Discord integration and setup instructions in the <href href='https://github.com/SteamServerUI/StationeersServerUI/wiki/Discord-Integration'>Wiki.</href>
tabDescriptions.UIText_SLPModIntegrationTabDescription: Easily manage your Stationeers mods with our Stationeers Launch Pad (SLP) integration. Learn more about the SLP integration in the <href href='https://github.com/SteamServerUI/StationeersServerUI/wiki/Modding-with-StationeersLaunchPad'>Wiki.</href>

basic.UIText_SaveFileNameInfo: Name of save folder. Must be capitalized. To create a new world, provide the World type to generate. It is recommended to use the Wizard to configure this value correctly.
basic.UIText_ServerPasswordInfo: Password needed to connect to the server. Leave empty for no password
basic.UIText_AdminPasswordInfo: Server Admin Password. VERY Legacy, unused in current Stationeers versions (as far as we know) - Leave empty unless you know what this parameter does (and let us know if you do!)
basic.UIText_AutoSaveInfo: Set to TRUE to enable automatic saving
basic.UIText_SaveIntervalInfo: Time in seconds between saves. Recommended to not recede 60 seconds.
basic.UIText_AutoPauseServerInfo: Automatically pause server when no players are connected
basic.UIText_SaveNameInfo: Name of the save folder, like 'MySave' or 'Europa Brutal'. This is the name of the folder that will be created in the 'saves' folder. Changing this value to a non-existent folder name will create a new save.
basic.UIText_WorldIDInfo: Choose a world discovered in the installed game files, or enter an exact custom world ID.

network.UIText_LocalIpAddressInfo: IP address to bind to. Recommended to leave at 0.0.0.0 unless you really know what you're doing.
network.UIText_StartLocalHostInfo: Keep this true. This is required for the server to work.
network.UIText_ServerVisibleInfo: Set to TRUE to list server publicly
network.UIText_AdvertiserSummary: Let SSUI advertise a different public address for this server.
network.UIText_AdvertiserExplanation: If this server is behind CGNAT, a reverse proxy, or a complex network setup, you can override the address announced to the Stationeers server list.
network.UIText_AdvertiserMasterServer: When enabled, SSUI takes over communication with the Stationeers master server and disables the game's native ServerVisible advertisement.
network.UIText_AdvertiserRestartWarning: Saving stops the running game server and restarts SSUI. The game server will not be started again automatically unless automatic startup is enabled.
network.UIText_AdvertiserRestarting: Configuration saved. The game server is stopping and SSUI is restarting...

advanced.UIText_TLSCertificateSummary: Replace SSUI's HTTPS certificate and private key.
advanced.UIText_TLSCertificateExplanation: Upload the certificate presented by SSUI and its matching private key. The pair is validated before the current files are replaced.
advanced.UIText_TLSCertificateFormats: Supports PEM or DER X.509 certificates and unencrypted PKCS#8, RSA PKCS#1, or EC SEC1 keys. Certificate chains may be supplied in one PEM file. PFX/P12 and encrypted keys are not supported.
advanced.UIText_TLSRestartWarning: Saving stops the running game server and restarts SSUI. Verify the certificate covers the hostname you use before continuing.
advanced.UIText_TLSRestarting: Certificate installed. The game server is stopping and SSUI is restarting...
advanced.UIText_ServerAuthSecretInfo: Authentication secret for the server. Needed to run console commands from the client (optional). SSUI also allows console commands from the WebUI and Discord.
advanced.UIText_ServerExePathInfo2: Not editable from the UI for security reasons, but you can edit it manually in the config.json file.
advanced.UIText_ShowExpertSettingsInfo: Enable the separate Expert Settings tab. This preference is saved immediately.
advanced.UIText_ExpertSettingsWarning: These options affect SSUI internals. Change them only when you understand their impact.
advanced.UIText_AutoRestartServerTimerInfo: Timeframe in minutes or time format (e.g., 15:04 or 03:04PM) to schedule an automatic gameserver restart. 0 = disabled, 1440 = 24 hours, etc. Configurable warning countdown (see below) uses the announce command to notify players ingame
advanced.UIText_AutoRestartCountdownInfo: Seconds of warning countdown before an automatic restart (default 65s).
advanced.UIText_GameBranchInfo: Branch of the game to use. When changed, requires to restart SSUI or press the Update Server button on the Main dashboard!
advanced.UIText_AllowAutoGameServerUpdatesInfo: Allow the gameserver to automatically query for and update to the latest version. Attention: Restarts the server when a new version was found and installed. Will send multiple warning messages to the sever with SAY commands 60-10 seconds before the restart.
advanced.UIText_AutoStartServerOnStartupInfo: Automatically start the gameserver when the SSUI is started. Defaults to false.
advanced.UIText_CreateSSUILogFileInfo: Create log files for the SSUI log in SSUI/logs. Defaults to false.
advanced.UIText_CreateGameServerLogFileInfo: Create a unique log file per server start for the gameserver in SSUI/logs. Defaults to false.

terrain.UIText_TerrainWarning: You can leave these settings blank to default to the defaults of the selected world type. Once a World is created, these settings no longer have an effect.
terrain.UIText_DifficultyInfo: Optional. Leave blank for the game's default, or choose a discovered difficulty.
terrain.UIText_StartConditionInfo: Optional. Requires Difficulty because Stationeers parses these values in order.
terrain.UIText_StartLocationInfo: Optional. Requires Difficulty and Start Condition; custom IDs remain supported.
terrain.UIText_TerrainSettingsFillHint: Please fill out the fields before the one you filled with a value, else Stationeers will have parsing issues.

discord.UIText_DiscordAdminRoleInfo: Only members with this role may use admin actions and slash commands in the hub. /status is available to everyone in the hub. Leave empty to disable admin actions. Enable Discord Developer Mode, then right-click the role and copy its ID.
discord.UIText_RotateServerPasswordInfo: Automatically rotates the server password on each server start. Players can get the current password via a button in the Server Status Panel Channel.
discord.UIText_EventLogChannelInfo: Optional channel where Event notifications (player joins, saves, server status) are displayed. If empty, this behaviour is skipped.
discord.UIText_StatusPanelChannelInfo: Shared server hub with live status, connected players, backup statistics and private admin actions. Existing status-panel channels keep working. Leave empty to disable the hub and its commands.
discord.UIText_LogChannelInfo: Optional channel that displays the full Gameserver log output. If empty, this behaviour is skipped.
discord.UIText_BannedPlayersListPathInfo: File path to banned players list
discord.UIText_DiscordVotingInfo: Allow Discord users to start and join votes from the server status panel. Required votes are calculated from the connected-player count when a vote starts.

slp.UIText_SLP_Description: Stationeers Launch Pad is a simple mod loader for Stationeers. It automatically updates itself and makes mod management easy.
slp.UIText_SLP_ReadyToInstall: Ready to install? Click the button below to get started.
slp.UIText_SLP_UploadDescription: Select a mod package (modpkg) zip file or drag and drop it into the box below to upload and extract mods.
slp.UIText_SLP_UploadDescriptionLink: Mod packages need to be exported from your game client. See the
slp.UIText_SLP_InstallFirstSubtext: SLP must be installed to upload mod packages
slp.UIText_SLP_OrClickToSelect: or click to select a mod package file
slp.UIText_SLP_UninstallWarning: Uninstalling will DELETE all mods in the Mods folder.
slp.UIText_SLP_UpdateWorkshopModsDesc: Update all installed workshop mods to their latest versions. This process may take some time depending on the number of mods.

setup.UIText_FooterText: Need help? Check the Stationeers Server UI Github Wiki.
setup.UIText_FooterTextInfo: You may exit the wizard at any time, each step is saved individually.
setup.UIText_SSCM_FooterText: Use SSCM for the most powerful Stationeers server management! You can run commands from the Web console without disrupting vanilla behaviour!
setup.UIText_PlsRead_StepMessage: You may change the language in the top right corner. This setup will take about 5 minutes to complete. We strongly recommend you to read the texts in this setup wizard! Most reported issues occur because of a misconfiguration.
setup.UIText_ServerName_StepMessage: Give your server a name like 'Space Station 13'
setup.UIText_SaveIdentifier_StepMessage: Configue your savegame name and world type from the options below.
setup.UIText_SaveIdentifier_SecondaryPlacehold: Click to select a world type
setup.UIText_MaxPlayers_StepMessage: Choose the maximum number of players that can connect to the server. Recommended to not exceed 20
setup.UIText_ServerPassword_StepMessage: Set a gameserver password or skip this step.
setup.UIText_GameBranch_StepMessage: Enter a beta branch or skip this to use the release version. If switching branches, make sure to click Update Server on the Main dashboard after completing this wizzard.
setup.UIText_SaveName_StepMessage: Configure the name of the savegame. This is the name of the folder that will be created in the 'saves' folder.
setup.UIText_WorldID_StepMessage: Select your preferred map to play on.
setup.UIText_NetworkConfigChoice_StepMessage: Do you want to configure network settings? Enter 'yes' to configure or Skip to use defaults. Note: Network configuration is especially important on Linux servers.
setup.UIText_GamePort_StepMessage: Enter the port number for game connections
setup.UIText_UpdatePort_StepMessage: Enter the port number for update connections
setup.UIText_UPnPEnabled_StepMessage: Enable UPnP? Enter 'yes' to enable or 'no' to disable.
setup.UIText_LocalIPAddress_StepMessage: Enter the IP address to bind to. Recommended to leave at 0.0.0.0 unless you really know what you're doing.
setup.UIText_AdminAccount_StepMessage: Set up your SSUI admin account.
setup.UIText_Finalize_StepMessage: Ready to finalize? Your configuration has already been saved while you completed this setup. If you want to change any of the settings, you may click Return to Start and skip whatever you want to keep. Most options can also be changed on the config Tab in the UI later.

gamemgr.BackendText_ServerNotRunningOrAlreadySto: Server was not running or was already stopped
